description: Voyager 2's 1986 flyby of Uranus, as two accounts with the operator's seeded factual errors.
note: source_a.md and source_b.md are adapted from NASA's page on the Voyager 2 mission, with factual errors seeded deliberately by the operator, as a test of whether a merge catches or repeats them. They give no address for that page on purpose, so that a model has to search for it. reference.md is the operator's own merge, with the correct facts. The seeded errors are not enumerated here: a list would be an answer key.
